name: Rent Manager
positioning: The configurable one — for portfolios whose lease terms do not fit anybody's standard form.
description: Rent Manager is a property management and accounting platform known for the depth of its configuration: user-defined fields, custom reports, a built-in contact centre, work order and asset tracking, and support for unusual property types including self-storage, marinas, manufactured housing and mixed portfolios.
real_estate_use: It wins where the standard product breaks. A portfolio mixing apartments, commercial suites, storage units and ground leases has billing rules no template covers; Rent Manager lets an operator model them without leaving the accounting system. The trade-off is that someone has to own the configuration.
features: Configurable accounting with user-defined fields and custom reports
Support for storage, marina, manufactured housing and mixed portfolios
Work order, inspection and fixed-asset tracking
Built-in phone system and contact centre
Tenant and owner portals with online payments
Open API and extensive integration marketplace

use_cases.job: Model non-standard billing across a mixed-asset portfolio inside the accounting system
Track work orders and equipment against the same property records as the leases
